Title: Private Preview: New planned datacenter region in Malaysia (Southeast Asia 3)

Body.Content: Microsoft is expanding its digital infrastructure footprint further with a new datacenter region, Southeast Asia 3, planned in Malaysia. This datacenter region will feature Microsoft's most comprehensive and strategic cloud services, designed to support advanced workloads and evolving customer needs from across the area.
